statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
